$comment: The role policy for StudyBuddy's custom agents, owned by the security team. Each agent has one role; a role says what it may do (read, search, edit, execute, web, agent, todo, mcp:read, mcp:write) and who may start it. Every role is "invocation": "explicit" (only a person or a script starts it, with --agent or /agent) except the reviewer: an agent that can change files, run commands or reach a service is never picked by inference, and a read-only specialist (triage, portal) would otherwise take questions meant for the main agent. The reviewer only reads, and being handed a review is its job. Read by scripts/audit-agents.mjs. It lives outside .github/agents/ on purpose: Copilot loads every .md file in there as an agent.

reviewer.why: Eyes, not hands: it only reads, so the main agent may hand it a review.

test-writer.why: Writes and runs tests; which files it may touch is up to its instructions.

fixer.why: Changes code and runs the tests; the review decides what to fix.

docs.why: Writes text; it never needs to run anything.

triage.why: Sorts reports; a person decides what happens next.

release.why: Runs the tests and reads the history; a person publishes.

portal-reader.why: Answers from the portal; it never changes it.

coverage.why: Runs the tests with coverage and reports; it changes nothing.
